tests.name: Routers are reachable over the OOB network with SSH and RESTCONF
Management interface lives in Mgmt-vrf with a default route to the host
License boot level provides the security feature set
AAA, SSH and VTY hardening from the NAC baseline
WAN point-to-point interfaces are up with the modelled addresses
Each spoke reaches the hub across its own link and nothing else
CDP shows the hub on each spoke's WAN port and both spokes on the hub
Loopbacks carry the router-id and the site LAN
Each tunnel is a static VTI sourced from the WAN link and protected by the IPsec profile
Tunnels are up/up at both ends and the tunnel subnet is reachable
IKEv2 SAs are READY with the modelled proposal and PSK authentication
Traffic through the tunnels is encrypted with the modelled transform set
The hub holds exactly one IKEv2 session per spoke
Hub has an Established eBGP session with each spoke over its tunnel
Every spoke peers with the hub only and receives four prefixes
Spokes see each other's LAN and loopback via the hub with the AS path hub-spoke
Hub learns each spoke's LAN directly from that spoke
Site LANs reach each other through the encrypted tunnels
Terraform plan reports no drift from the NAC data model
Routers exist in Nautobot with role, serial, platform and management IP matching reality
WAN links are modelled as cables between the hub and spoke ports with /30 addresses
The VPN is modelled in Nautobot's core VPN app: one VPN, one tunnel per spoke, hub/spoke endpoints
The IKEv2/IPsec suite comes from the VPN profile's Phase 1 / Phase 2 policies and matches the routers
BGP model: one AS per site, eBGP peerings over the tunnel addresses matching the live sessions
NAC device model rendered from Nautobot matches the committed file
Golden Config: router backups are in Gitea and every compliance row is compliant
